scoring_rule: As S3/S4/R2: a case is CORRECT iff every scored check holds and no exception is raised; check types claim, line, identical, custody (S3 run_checks) plus witness_binding (the G-INV witness's BIND_* list) and custody_why_contains. A SOUND case is correct when accepted; a BROKEN case is correct when rejected -- an accepted broken case is a survivor. Every case runs on two bases: 'synthetic' (fixtures.evidence_cases synthetic G0) and 'r1' (the committed C-009 fresh produce rso/binding/R1/G0, real executions, 26-row inventory, producer-bound). Probes are recorded, never scored, and do not enter CLOSED / NOT CLOSED.

bundles.BASELINE: evidence_cases.g0(base) under the frozen code (fixture store: stage rows only; custody UNQUALIFIED by KEEPER_ROW_MISSING on both bases)
bundles.KEEPER: evidence_cases.keeper(base): manifest, inventory, table and stage records registered in a fixture store, anchors from the keeper; custody QUALIFIED. Control for FAILED_RETRY_KEEPER

cases.note: The contract's letter (BX2: the cited row binds; BX5: RUN_UNREPORTED is 'a required node without a presented receipt') admits this shape. The checks state what a qualifying consumer should do; if they fail the case is an ADMITTED survivor for adjudication, not a scoring error.

probes.reading: CC1's LAUNCH_SUBSTITUTION shape (not fresh; T011's regression) consumed through s2_run.consumer_for, the path s2_run.decisions_real and the CC2 matrix use. consumer_for builds EV.Bundle without run_id (T011 receipt, notes (1), asked T020 to pass run_id=g.run_id; the frozen s2_run.py does not), so the reviewer expects the production path to report G-INV PASS where the fixture path (run_id passed) reports LAUNCH_UNBOUND.
